## Quality Checklist

Before submitting, please confirm:

- [ ] Template follows the [Template Specification](https://github.com/lightspeedwp/.github/blob/develop/docs/ai/template-spec.md)
- [ ] Includes all required sections (Goal, Inputs, Instructions, Quality Checks, Safety & Limits, Examples)
- [ ] Uses kebab-case naming convention
- [ ] Has been tested with the target AI model
- [ ] Includes appropriate safety guidelines
- [ ] Provides at least one complete example
- [ ] Front matter is complete and accurate
- [ ] Content is original or properly attributed
